summary: The signüll account expects AI agents to become the main interface to life and work, and writes about the data and competition they bring.

statements.quote: software used to have so much friction that building things selected for a very specific type of often strange person but ai removes most of that activation energy altogether.
so you’re now potentially also competing with someone’s agent esp for high demand low supply things.
the agent will be the default interface to your personal & professional life.
this is the real singularity: not that machines can answer, but that humans can now question with superintelligence as their partner.
statements.venue: Essay, answers are now insanely cheap

statements.quote: this is the most valuable data on the planet, it will be used to nudge you, build around you, or even simulate you
